owner_direction.scope: Bounded summary requested: classic mode checkbox Knave2e affects new map generation. Defer standalone KNAVE2-PLACE1 prompts. No inferred product implementation or release approval.

limitations: PDF43 returned image pointer only; example map not visually assessed in this run
Static code comparison only; no full runtime coverage audit

proposed_adjustments.item: Classic checkbox and saved Knave2 profile
proposed_adjustments.basis: Explicit owner UI direction; product choice
proposed_adjustments.behavior: Apply to new map/new generation; preserve old documents. Switching checkbox does not silently regenerate existing objects.
Store physical size and units separately from screen zoom. Exact geometric convention remains unspecified by source.

proposed_adjustments.item: POI generation by Knave content profiles
proposed_adjustments.behavior: Reuse existing icons/POI persistence; map natural places, structures, dungeon concepts and traits to suitable generated objects. Tables may inspire content; not all location words become new biomes, nor automatically overwrite geographic rivers/lakes.
proposed_adjustments.current: Classic has own central/secondary type lists and constraints, density floor(eligible/6)..floor(eligible/4), distinct secondary kinds within region.
proposed_adjustments.open: Knave has no universal POI density, region size distribution or mandatory number of POIs. Any revised distribution must be explicit product policy, not invented book rule.

proposed_adjustments.behavior: Separate passability/difficulty from biome; store independent flag/annotation. Automatic biome-to-difficulty mapping is product policy; no full travel computation in L1.
Distinguish visible during passage, discoverable with hex exploration, secrets found by interaction; connect secret to clue. Preparation data now; automatic reveal/fog and watch costs are later L2.

later_optional: Settlement services, NPCs, monsters and all auxiliary prompt tables
unchanged_geography: No separate Knave biome/river/region-size generation algorithm found in thematic source inventory; retain existing algorithms as generator choices. Example map not a mandatory distribution.
excluded: Travel clock, watch actions, hazard die, weather, navigation and encounter resolution
recommended_first_scope: Classic+Knave checkbox, saved profile, physical6mile scale, generated POI content profile, independent difficult terrain and discovery/clue data. Exact density/default policies remain to settle in bounded specification.

score.note: No product implementation or full criterion assessment; current score unchanged
